records.Concise description: Exchange using the BTCC/BTC China lineage, originating in 2011 and currently operating spot and futures products.
records.Deeper researched summary: BTCC markets itself as an exchange founded in June 2011 and one of the longest-running crypto trading brands. Current product/support material shows active spot and futures account infrastructure. The corporate and ownership lineage from the original BTC China business through later BTCC operations is less cleanly documented in current first-party materials than the lifecycle itself, so the record keeps MEDIUM source confidence and avoids overclaiming founder/current-entity continuity.
Creators / founders: Original BTC China / BTCC founding team — current first-party founder attribution not sufficiently re-verified
records.Launch / history: BTCC states that it was founded in June 2011. The business later evolved from the BTC China era into an internationally branded spot/derivatives platform.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin exchange e: It preserves a direct lineage to one of Bitcoin's earliest large exchange brands and helps document early China-centered BTC market development.
records.Verification basis: Current BTCC first-party site/support material verifies active operation and the brand's stated June 2011 origin; corporate lineage is incomplete enough to retain MEDIUM confidence.
Research notes / uncertainties: Current operation is verified, but exact continuity among the original BTC China entity, later owners and current BTCC operating entities should not be compressed into a single unqualified corporate-history sentence.

records.Concise description: Latin American custodial exchange founded in Mexico in 2014 with durable BTC/fiat market significance and regional payment infrastructure.
records.Deeper researched summary: Bitso started in Mexico in 2014 with a mission to make cryptocurrencies useful and accessible in Latin America. It grew from a Bitcoin-focused exchange into a broader custodial financial app serving multiple Latin American markets. Bitcoin remains foundational to its history and trading/on-ramp role. Regulatory permissions and product availability differ by country and legal entity, so MSC should not apply one jurisdiction's registration to the whole region.
records.Launch / history: Founded in Mexico in 2014 and expanded across Latin America as an exchange, payments and digital-asset platform.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin exchange e: Bitso is one of the earliest durable Bitcoin/fiat exchange bridges in Latin America and materially influenced regional on/off-ramp infrastructure.
records.Verification basis: Current Bitso first-party material verifies active operation, 2014 start and Latin American focus; founder history is corroborated by reputable institutional ecosystem sources.
Research notes / uncertainties: Do not cite current user counts or volume as durable inclusion evidence.
Regulatory statements must be made per country/entity.

records.Concise description: Brazilian exchange founded in 2013, among the earliest durable BTC/BRL on-ramps in Latin America.
records.Deeper researched summary: Mercado Bitcoin (MB) began in 2013 and became an important Brazilian route between reais and bitcoin before expanding into a broader digital-asset/tokenization platform. Its current official history still centers the 2013 launch and Brazilian market. Current regulatory claims are evolving under Brazil's virtual-asset framework and MB's European entity, so legal copy should identify the relevant regulator and entity rather than state that the whole group is uniformly regulated.
records.Launch / history: Founded in Brazil in 2013 by brothers Gustavo and Maurício Chamati; later expanded beyond crypto spot trading into digital-asset and tokenization services.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin exchange e: Mercado Bitcoin is one of Latin America's earliest continuously operating BTC/fiat exchanges and an important historical Brazilian on-ramp.
Important technical or cultural characte: Brazil and Europe have separate regulatory contexts
records.Verification basis: Current Mercado Bitcoin first-party history and company pages verify active operation, founders and 2013 launch.
Research notes / uncertainties: Do not reuse company claims about rankings/user counts as timeless facts.
Brazilian regulatory status is changing and must be rechecked before publication.

records.Concise description: Japanese Bitcoin exchange founded in 2014 with long-running JPY/BTC infrastructure and regulated exchange operations.
records.Deeper researched summary: bitFlyer was incorporated in January 2014 by Yuzo Kano and Takafumi Komiyama, in part as a response to weaknesses they observed in the Mt. Gox era. It remains an active custodial exchange with Japanese registration for crypto-asset exchange services and other financial instruments. The product name 'bitFlyer Lightning' is an advanced trading interface and must not be mistaken for evidence that deposits/withdrawals use the Bitcoin Lightning Network.
records.Launch / history: Incorporated in Japan on January 9, 2014 and developed into a major JPY/BTC exchange with later U.S. and European operations.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin exchange e: bitFlyer is a durable bridge between the Mt. Gox aftermath and Japan's formalized crypto-exchange regulatory era.
Important technical or cultural characte: Advanced trading interface named 'Lightning' is not itself Bitcoin Lightning Network support
records.Verification basis: Current bitFlyer corporate material verifies incorporation date, founders/current leadership lineage and Japanese registrations; current trading pages verify active operation.
Research notes / uncertainties: Do not state that 'bitFlyer Lightning' means Bitcoin Lightning Network deposits/withdrawals; the name refers to a trading product/interface.
Licenses/registrations must be matched to the relevant country entity.
